definitions.short: properly, foot (as consumed); i.e. (by exten.) of cattle brutishness ; (concretely) stupid
definitions.full: H1198. baar בַּ֫עַר noun masculine brutishness (only in poetry) — absolute ׳ב Psa 49:11 3 t., בָּ֑עַר Prov 12:1 ; — combination, ׳אִישׁבֿ brutish man Psa 92:7 (|| כסיל ); elsewhere ׳ב alone in same sense (concrete) 49:11 (|| id. ), & as predicate = adjective, 73:22 ; Prov 12:1 ; 30:2 .
